title: ExecutionContract
description: Native structured contract (domain F). Cursor Markdown is adapter export only (domain G). Immutable after confirmed except explicit supersession via a successor contract. schemaVersion 0.2.0-oa is a breaking bump from 0.1.0-oa (requiredAuthority enum closure + supersession fields). Ownership: T-A4 may produce draft|proposed|validated|confirmation_required|confirmed|cancelled|superseded; T-A5 owns agent selection and executing|completed|failed. Reverse superseded-by link is derived at runtime from successors' supersedesExecutionContractId (one direction only).

schemaVersion.description: Breaking vs 0.1.0-oa: requiredAuthority closed to N1|N2|N3|MORRIS; supersedesExecutionContractId + supersessionReason added.

cycleInstanceId.description: Optional cycle link. Critical cycle still proposed/non-acknowledged: contract must not reach confirmed (runtime fail-closed; R-T-A3-1 OPEN).

decisionRefs.description: Structuring contracts require ≥1 accepted, same-project, non-superseded decision at build and at confirm (runtime). After confirmed, if a source decision is later superseded, contract must not start new execution until superseded or cancelled (runtime T-A4→T-A5 gate).

confirmationRef.description: When status=confirmed, references the T-A3 Confirmation consumed exactly once at ConfirmExecutionContract. Build/Validate must not consume Confirmation.

requiredAuthority.description: Canonical T-A3 mapping. N1|N2|N3 are Confirmation/Authority levels. N3 ≠ Morris: requiredAuthority=N3 does not confer canActAsMorris. MORRIS means verified N3 AND canActAsMorris=true (normative; not a hierarchical level above N3). Real authority always verified by T-A3 AuthorityResolverPort — never trust client claims.

selectedAgentRef.description: T-A5 ownership only (SelectExecutionAgent). T-A4 governance must not set this field.

status.description: Single schema covers full lifecycle (Option A). T-A4 may produce: draft, proposed, validated, confirmation_required, confirmed, cancelled (pre-exec), superseded. T-A5 owns: executing, completed, failed (and agent selection). T-A4 must not produce T-A5 statuses; T-A5 must not rewrite prior governance statuses.

version.description: Monotone object version (OCC). Successor superseding contracts use a new executionContractId; do not mutate confirmed content in place.

supersedesExecutionContractId.description: Optional id of the contract this successor replaces. One direction only; reverse supersededBy is derived at runtime. Must use xct: prefix. Must not equal this.executionContractId (runtime invariant — Draft-07 cannot compare properties).

supersessionReason.description: Required when supersedesExecutionContractId is present OR status=superseded. Must contain ≥1 non-whitespace character (catalog: raison non vide — whitespace/NBSP-only rejected).

adapterExportRef.description: Secondary Cursor Markdown export — never native contract

then.description: status=superseded requires supersessionReason. Relational proof that a successor points here via supersedesExecutionContractId is a runtime invariant (reverse link derived).
confirmed requires confirmationRef (consumed Confirmation) and ≥1 decisionRef. Semantic freshness of decision/Critical ack remain runtime.
